items.q: What services does Yajurved Construction offer in Nashik?
items.a: Yajurved Construction Pvt. Ltd. offers five services in Nashik: construction and housing society redevelopment, property title verification and documentation, MahaRERA registration support, property litigation consultancy, and financial consultancy for redevelopment projects.

items.q: How long does a housing society redevelopment take in Nashik?
items.a: Most society redevelopments take two to four years from the first general body meeting to handing over new flats. Roughly six to twelve months go into consent, developer selection and approvals, and the rest into demolition and construction. The size of the plot and the speed of approvals make the biggest difference.

items.q: Which documents are needed to check a property title in Maharashtra?
items.a: A title check usually needs the 7/12 extract or property card, mutation entries, the chain of sale deeds for at least 30 years, the non-agricultural (NA) order where relevant, approved building plans, and a search report from the Sub-Registrar office for mortgages or other charges.

items.q: Does my project need MahaRERA registration?
items.a: In Maharashtra, a project generally needs MahaRERA registration before it is advertised or sold if the land is larger than 500 square metres or it has more than eight apartments. Registration needs title documents, approved plans, a separate project bank account and quarterly progress reports.
